headline: Application role would gain read/write access to all S3 buckets in the account — wildcard S3 access is not acceptable trade for operational convenience.

findings.evidence_ref: default = ["*"] in the diff — replaces specific bucket ARNs with wildcard
findings.explanation: The application role will now read and write any S3 bucket in the account, not just the intended analytics bucket. If the application is compromised, an attacker gains access to all company data stored in S3, including backups, configuration, and other sensitive buckets.
